calculation.expression: -sum_5(asset_log_return - beta_60_DXY * DXY_log_return) / (sqrt(5) * sd_60(asset_log_return)) * clip(1 + sd_60(cross_asset_mean_return) / mean_60(abs(cross_asset_mean_return)), 1, 2)
calculation.description: Fades the asset's five-day return residual after removing its trailing 60-day DXY sensitivity, scales by trailing volatility, and applies a bounded market-dispersion amplifier. All inputs are lagged through the prior completed day.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in 2020-24 (+0.027274), 2025-27 (+0.039251), 2028-29 (+0.027993), 2030-31 (+0.019482), and 2032 YTD (+0.099206; 14 observations). Recent Aug 2031-Feb 2032 IC was +0.084854 over 123 observations; interpret short recent samples cautiously.
